observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function report_backfill_finished that records a background backfill completion event, including status and stop reason, while suppressing exceptions to avoid failing the workflow.
observations.posthog_connection: Records a background event for an AI evaluation backfill completion, preserving the workflow's ability to complete even if the analytics capture fails.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function _fail_backfill that calls cancel_backfill and then reports the backfill as finished with status failed.
observations.posthog_connection: Records a failed status for a backfill after cancellation, while suppressing exceptions to avoid failing the workflow.

observations.behavior: Updates the prepare_evaluation_backfill_tick_activity to report the backfill as finished with a stop reason when the evaluation is deleted, disabled, or unsupported.
observations.posthog_connection: Records a stopped status for a backfill when the underlying evaluation is no longer available, while suppressing exceptions to avoid failing the workflow.
